title: Tail 512 Hydraulic Discrepancy Report

sections.heading: 2. Description
sections.body: Hydraulic System B on tail 512 showed slow pressure decay grounding the aircraft over a three hour window. See Figure 2 for the schematic.

sections.heading: 3. Timeline
sections.body: Hydraulic low advisory at 05:41; discrepancy logged 05:50; returned to service after seal replacement at 12:50.

sections.heading: 4. Contributing Factors
sections.body: Actuator-controller software B2.5 was running on the affected unit. The actuator seal was degraded.
